craft_notes: Sthāyin: utkrānti unit 55. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 2. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: All enjoyment ugly, but having deemed, body should abandon if: then by
that, quickly by sequence, joined, samayin, Śiva.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sarvaṃ bhogaṃ virūpaṃ tu matvā dehaṃ tyajedyadi tadā tena krameṇāśu yojitaḥ samayī śivaḥ
